 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the full-width and full-height separator lines by their near-uniform color.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if max(Counter(row).values()) >= 0.85 * w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if max(Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).values()) >= 0.85 * h]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        raise ValueError('separator lines not detected')
    line_color = Counter(Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in row_lines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The interior color is the most common value not used for the separators or intersection markers.
    # In these puzzles it is the dominant color away from the separator lines.
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in row_lines and c not in col_lines]
    fill_color = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]], grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci+1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri+1]][col_lines[ci]], grid[row_lines[ri+1]][col_lines[ci+1]]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(fill_color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
